(2) The code may include provision—
(a) that a police officer identified in accordance with prescribed provisions must
carry out a prescribed activity which the code requires;
(b) that a police officer so identified must take steps to secure the carrying out
by a person (whether or not a police officer) of a prescribed activity which
the code requires;
(c) that a duty must be discharged by different people in succession in prescribed
circumstances (as where a person dies or retires).
Criminal Procedure and Investigations Act 1996 (c. 25)
Part II – Criminal Investigations
